Buyer Added Bid Specific Scope Of Work(SOW) Text Clause(s) SCOPE OF WORK FOR THERMAL INSULATION OF 10KL & 3KL SS RE ACTORS IN ACRYLIC PLANT 10 KL & 3 KL SS REACTOR INSULATION:

1. Erection of scaffolding and removal of the same after completion of work including suppl y of Scaffolding materials. 2. Cleaning the surface of Equipments and application of one coat of Heat Resistant Alumin ium paint of 250° C withstanding capacity. 3. Supply, Fabrication and fixing of MS Spacer rings with 25mm x 3 mm thick MS Flat to hol d LRB Mattress. 4. Supply, Fabrication and fixing of Lightly Resin Bonded mineral wool mattress Confirming to IS 8183 of Density 100 Kg/ M3, thickness 100mm, backed on one Side with G.I Wire mes h and stitched with 22 SWG GI lacing wire. 5. Supply, fabrication and fixing of Aluminium sheet of 22 SWG thick with proper Grooves& overlaps and secured with Self tapping screws. Quantity to be insulated – 200 SqM The Quantity is Approximate. The actual area Insulated will only be billed after completion of work. Site Visit mandatory. All Safety norms to be adhered. 4. Not e: For work orders released for carrying out work at our units (SBU: Chemicals, Industria l Packaging, Greases & Lubricants) located at Manali, Chennai. Order copies are sufficie nt) 5) Site Visit: Vendor should submit the offer only after visiting our site for understanding th e technical requirement clearly as per site condition. Site visit form (enclosed as Annexur e-3) duly signed by vendor’s representative, BL Technical and HR representative on visit s hould be submitted The offer will be rejected in the absence of the above prequalification criteria& EMD – who are not exempted. Relevant certificate copies should be submitted as hard c opies with self-attestation. The tenderer should not have been blacklisted by any PSU/Govt. Department (a self- certific

ation is required). This is subject to verification by Balmer Lawrie and if found to be false, the bidd er may be debarred from participating in the tender, or order already placed will be cancelled. The offer will be rejected in the absence of the above registrations, Relevant certificate c opies should be submitted as hard copies.
